text.arabic_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

words.gloss_range: negative particle targeting the following imperfect verb and beginning the negative-exception frame
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the ayah by denying leaving before the result is named. It targets the following imperfect verb, so the reader first hears the wind defined by non-sparing rather than by a bare destruction verb. The particle also begins the negative-exception funnel completed later by word 7: every alternative to the final making is excluded before the one permitted outcome appears.

topics.headline: negation targets the verb
topics.summary: The particle selects negative force over relative or interrogative readings and scopes over the following imperfect.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening is a denial of the wind's leaving or sparing, not a vague negative mood.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a negative particle governing the imperfect predicate, and the local clause confirms verbal negation.

topics.headline: negative-exception funnel begins
topics.summary: The particle starts the restriction that word 7 closes, excluding alternatives before the result clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move through a logical funnel: denied sparing, scoped object, reached field, then one exclusive outcome.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the later exception clause as completing the negative construction begun here.

topics.headline: sparing is denied first
topics.summary: The ayah starts by naming what the wind never does before showing what it does.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels destruction introduced through exclusion: the first claim is that no spared remainder is allowed.
topics.reason: The word order makes negation the entry point before object and result are supplied.

words.gloss_range: does not leave, spare, or let remain; local negated imperfect makes non-sparing the wind's operating rule
words.root_gloss_range: leaving or letting be is the active branch here; detached-piece and cutting branches remain lexical background but are not selected
words.prose: {{ar:تَذَرُ}} ({{tr:tadharu}}) keeps the wind grammatically present through feminine singular agreement, even though the subject is not repeated. Its imperfect aspect under negation makes non-sparing the wind's characteristic rule, while the later perfect verbs narrate each completed encounter and transformation. The root's local branch is leaving or letting remain, so the word defines destruction by the refused alternative: the thing is not left as it was, but carried toward making into a ruined likeness. The defective distribution of {{ar:و ذ ر}} ({{tr:w-dh-r}}) supports the prominence of this imperfect form without turning that paradigm fact into a separate local sense.

topics.headline: feminine agreement keeps the wind
topics.summary: The feminine singular verb continues the wind from 51:41 as the silent subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actor is still the wind from 51:41, not an unspecified force or the local object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify 3FS agreement as continuing the previous wind as subject.

topics.headline: non-sparing as operating rule
topics.summary: Negated imperfect aspect makes non-sparing characteristic while the following perfects narrate completed acts.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears more than one event: the wind is characterized by a rule that whatever enters its reach is not exempted.
topics.reason: The verb is an imperfect under the negative particle, while the later encounter and making verbs are perfects.

topics.headline: leaving denied before making
topics.summary: The selected root branch is leaving or sparing, and the ayah contrasts that denied option with later making.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wind's destruction is framed as refusing to let anything remain before it is remade into ruin.
topics.reason: The local object frame and following result clause select the leaving or sparing branch and make the later making clause its contrast.

topics.headline: defective paradigm noted locally
topics.summary: The defective distribution of the verb helps explain why the imperfect form is salient, but it does not add an independent meaning.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form's paradigm profile reinforces attention to the imperfect without changing the local sense of non-sparing.
topics.reason: The local form is indeed imperfect; broader claims about defective distribution are useful only as form background.

topics.headline: warning root is not this root
topics.summary: The warning claim confuses a different root with the local root.
topics.blocking_evidence: The local root is {{ar:و ذ ر}} ({{tr:w-dh-r}}), while the warning noun belongs to a different root, so the claimed shared-root payoff is blocked.
topics.reason: QAC aligns the word to {{ar:و ذ ر}} ({{tr:w-dh-r}}), not the warning root, so the derivational claim cannot govern this word.

topics.headline: sound texture adds no separate payoff
topics.summary: The abrasive sound observation is less useful than the retained grammar and lexical topics.
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound description is impressionistic and does not add a distinct reader-facing payoff beyond non-sparing and scope.
topics.reason: The retained topics already preserve the lexical and structural force of the word.

words.gloss_range: preposition used as pleonastic scope intensifier under negation while still governing the following genitive
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) does not function here as an ordinary source preposition. Under negation it intensifies the object phrase into not any single thing whatsoever, yet it remains grammatically real by governing the following noun in genitive form. The payoff is both semantic and structural: total exclusion passes through a visible prepositional governor before the object is named.

topics.headline: pleonastic totality marker
topics.summary: Under negation, the preposition strengthens the object phrase into exhaustive not-any scope.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording excludes even one spared item, not merely a normal object after the verb.
topics.reason: QAC explicitly marks the preposition as strengthening universal quantification under negation.

topics.headline: extra but still governing
topics.summary: The preposition intensifies scope while still imposing genitive case on the following noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that Arabic can use an apparently extra particle without making it syntactically empty.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following noun as governed by the preposition while still serving the negated object domain.

topics.headline: domain widened before exception
topics.summary: The particle expands the set that the later exception will restrict to one outcome.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the later exception applies after the object domain has already been made exhaustive.
topics.reason: The preposition stands inside the negative clause that is later closed by the exception particle.

topics.headline: sound bond is secondary
topics.summary: The nasal sound observation duplicates the stronger grammatical bond.
topics.reason: The syntactic governor topic already preserves the attachment between particle and noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite thing or entity; under negation with the preceding preposition it yields exhaustive not-any scope
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood and will/volition are related in the broader root family, but the selected local noun is the broad entity term
words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) supplies the broadest object term, but its scope is not loose. As an indefinite singular under negation and the preceding intensifying preposition, it makes every possible reached entity count one by one. The genitive case comes from the preposition, while attachment evidence still treats the phrase as the semantic object of non-sparing. The following reach clause narrows the universe to whatever the wind came upon, so the universal claim is exhaustive within the wind's field of contact. The {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) root's will-related background can add ontological pressure, but the local sense remains the general noun for a thing.

topics.headline: indefinite thing gives total scope
topics.summary: The singular indefinite under negation and the preceding preposition yields exhaustive not-any force.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scope is distributive and exhaustive: not even one thing in the wind's reach is spared.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as indefinite genitive singular, and the preceding negative-plus-preposition construction licenses exhaustive scope.

topics.headline: genitive but still object
topics.summary: The noun is case-governed by the preposition while serving as the semantic object of the non-sparing verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep both facts together: the noun is genitive in form, yet it names what the wind does not leave.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the phrase as both governed by the preposition and the negated object domain of the verb.

topics.headline: broadest entity noun
topics.summary: The noun names any thing or entity rather than a narrow class of targets.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destruction is not class-specific; the broad entity term makes the claim as wide as the wind's contact field.
topics.reason: The local noun is the general entity term, and no local grammar narrows it to people or structures alone.

topics.headline: will background, not selected sense
topics.summary: The will-related root family can color thinghood but does not replace the local noun sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may sense formed existence under threat, while the local word still simply means a thing or entity.
topics.reason: V4 evidence supports related will and thing branches, but the local form and syntax select the noun of thinghood.

topics.headline: universal field is locally qualified
topics.summary: The following reach clause modifies the broad noun and narrows the universal scope to what the wind came upon.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is exhaustive inside the wind's contact zone, not a detached metaphysical claim about all existence.
topics.reason: The following relative clause is strongly licensed as a modifier of the indefinite noun.

topics.headline: thing carried into transformation
topics.summary: The broad thing term is later picked up by making, with echoes that contrast broader destruction and creation frames.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same entity held through reach and transformation, with the broad thing language contrasting human ruin in 69:7-8 and creation-pair language in 51:49.
topics.reason: The object is resumed later by pronoun, and the cited CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-theme references in 69:7-8 and 51:49.

topics.headline: sound boundary is secondary
topics.summary: The glottal-stop observation does not add a separate lexical or structural payoff.
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The phonetic observation is impressionistic and weaker than the retained singular-indefinite and scope topics.
topics.reason: The totalizing and object-continuity topics preserve the useful reader-facing value.

words.gloss_range: came upon or reached; with the following upon-phrase, locally narrowed to destructive contact rather than neutral arrival
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving are in the broader root range; the local upon-frame selects destructive reaching/contact
words.prose: {{ar:أَتَتْ}} ({{tr:atat}}) continues the same feminine wind as subject and shifts the broad object into a completed reach event. Its following upon-phrase prevents a neutral arrival reading: the local frame is coming upon as destructive contact. Because the verb sits in a postnominal qualifying clause, the ayah means every thing that the wind came upon, not every thing in abstraction. The perfect aspect pairs each completed encounter with the later completed making, so reach becomes the trigger for transformation. The broader {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) range includes giving elsewhere, but here that range is reversed into consuming arrival, with a same-surah contrast to giving in 51:16.

topics.headline: same wind remains subject
topics.summary: The feminine perfect continues the wind as agent through the reach clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same wind carries the action from non-sparing into reaching, rather than a new actor entering.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark 3FS agreement as continuing the prior wind.

topics.headline: reach clause qualifies the object
topics.summary: The verb forms the postnominal clause that filters the broad thing term by actual contact.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universal scope is locally filtered: the claim concerns every thing the wind came upon.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the phrase as a relative modifier of the indefinite object.

topics.headline: arrival narrowed to destructive contact
topics.summary: The following upon-phrase turns coming from neutral motion into hostile contact.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the wind does not merely arrive near the object; it comes upon it as the contact that consumes it.
topics.reason: The local prepositional complement is syntactically forced and selects the destructive upon-frame rather than a bare arrival sense.

topics.headline: completed reach triggers making
topics.summary: Perfect aspect and root pairing connect each completed encounter with the later transformation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-step mechanism: completed destructive contact is followed by completed state-conversion.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect in the reach clause, and the later making verb is also perfect with the same subject chain.

topics.headline: giving range reversed locally
topics.summary: The broader coming/giving range is not selected directly; it sharpens the contrast with destructive arrival, including 51:16.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root family can mark gift or news elsewhere in the surah, while here what comes is consuming wind, with 51:16 as a pointed contrast.
topics.reason: The local upon-frame blocks a gift sense, but same-surah root recurrence can remain as a contrast rather than the selected meaning.

topics.headline: commissioning becomes enacted operation
topics.summary: The ayah boundary shifts from divine sending in 51:41 to the wind's object-by-object action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene move from the sending of the punishment in 51:41 into the wind's enacted path through each object.
topics.reason: The subject is still the wind from 51:41, while the local clause now narrates what that sent wind does.

topics.headline: cadence observations are secondary
topics.summary: The sound rows do not add a distinct payoff beyond completed reach and transformation.
topics.reason: The aspect and sequencing topic already preserves the paired completed events.

words.gloss_range: upon it; preposition plus masculine suffix completing the destructive contact frame and resuming the thing
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) is the small word that makes the previous coming into coming upon. The preposition supplies hostile contact, while the masculine suffix resumes the earlier thing and keeps object identity intact. This creates two simultaneous chains: feminine wind as agent, masculine thing as patient. By closing the reach clause before the exception, the word seals the set of reached objects that will then receive the single outcome.

topics.headline: upon-frame creates hostile contact
topics.summary: The preposition attaches to the previous verb and changes the frame from arrival to coming upon.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contact is adversative and destructive, not merely spatial nearness.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the prepositional complement with the previous verb, licensing the destructive upon-frame.

topics.headline: suffix resumes the thing
topics.summary: The masculine suffix points back to the object, distinct from the feminine wind subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks two chains at once: feminine wind acts, masculine thing receives contact and later transformation.
topics.reason: The suffix is licensed as a resumptive reference to the masculine object noun, not to the feminine agent.

topics.headline: reach clause closes before exception
topics.summary: The word completes the qualifying reach clause before the exception particle opens the result.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sequence seal the contact field before the ayah pivots to the only outcome.
topics.reason: The clause boundary places this phrase immediately before the exception particle, completing the relative modifier.

topics.headline: recitation handoff is secondary
topics.summary: The sound movement into the exception duplicates the stronger syntactic handoff.
topics.reason: The clause-closure topic already preserves the handoff from reach to exception.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the negative-exception restriction and introducing the sole result clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge where denied sparing turns into the only positive result. It does more than mean except in isolation: with the opening negative particle it completes restriction by negation and exception. What follows is therefore not an optional sequel or ordinary coordination, but the exclusive answer to the whole negated frame.

topics.headline: exception scopes over result
topics.summary: The particle governs the following result clause as the sole exception to denied sparing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final result as obligatory and exclusive, not one possible aftermath among others.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following making clause as the exception outcome after the negated clause.

topics.headline: except becomes only
topics.summary: The surface exception particle also carries restriction in the paired construction.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both sides of the particle: it introduces an exception and makes that exception the only result.
topics.reason: The negative-exception construction licenses the restrictive force.

topics.headline: hinge replaces conjunction
topics.summary: The particle links denied sparing to making without ordinary coordination.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a pivot from what does not happen to what must happen, rather than a simple next event.
topics.reason: The particle itself supplies the relation between the negated clause and the result clause.

words.gloss_range: made or rendered it; locally a transformative making with the object suffix as patient and the following comparison phrase as result complement
words.root_gloss_range: broad making, rendering, placing, appointing, and constituting range; the local frame selects state-converting making, not simple placing
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَتْهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalathu}}) begins the only positive predicate allowed after the exception. The feminine verb keeps the same wind as agent, and the object suffix routes the exact reached thing into the making verb as patient. With the following comparison phrase as result complement, {{ar:ج ع ل}} ({{tr:j-ʿ-l}}) is locally narrowed to transformative rendering: the thing is made into a decay-like state, not merely placed somewhere. That makes the root's constitutive force feel inverted, because making usually suggests ordering or forming, while here the product is disintegration. The word also sharpens same-surah contrasts: a sign is left in 51:37, while here the wind makes its object into crumbled remains, and the root later returns in a prohibition frame at 51:51.

topics.headline: patient plus result complement
topics.summary: The suffix is the patient and the following comparison phrase supplies the result state.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same reached thing through the verb into a new decay-like state.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as object and the comparison phrase as governed complement of the making verb.

topics.headline: wind remains making agent
topics.summary: The feminine verb continues the wind as the immediate agent of transformation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sent wind is grammatically promoted into the doer of the final state-change.
topics.reason: The 3FS perfect continues the same subject chain from the previous verbs.

topics.headline: completed state conversion
topics.summary: The perfect verb pairs with the completed encounter and names finished transformation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's process finish: completed contact is completed by completed making.
topics.reason: The perfect result verb fills the exception clause after the completed reach clause.

topics.headline: making root inverted toward ruin
topics.summary: The broad constitutive making root is locally selected as destructive rendering, not simple placing or ordinary creation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a reversal: a root often associated with constituting or forming is used here to render every reached thing as decay-like ruin, with 6:1 as a creation contrast.
topics.reason: The local result complement selects rendering into a state; broader creative associations survive only as contrast, not as the local sense itself.

topics.headline: verb compresses action and patient
topics.summary: The verb, subject marking, and object suffix are fused in one word.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reached object pulled directly into the transformation rather than restated as a separate noun.
topics.reason: The surface word fuses the perfect verb with feminine subject marking and masculine object suffix.

topics.headline: thing becomes configured as ruin
topics.summary: The thing-root and making-root pairing supports the local transformation frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object remains a thing long enough to be reconfigured as decay-like remains.
topics.reason: The object suffix resumes the earlier thing, and the making verb supplies the state-conversion.

topics.headline: making contrasted with leaving a sign
topics.summary: Same-surah recurrence contrasts preserved witness in 51:37 and prohibition language in 51:51 with destructive making here.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind's making contrasted with 51:37, where a sign is left as witness, and with 51:51, where making another deity is prohibited.
topics.reason: The cited CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references for contrast.

topics.headline: rhythmic closure is secondary
topics.summary: The pacing observation is less useful than the retained transformation frame.
topics.reason: The completed-transformation topic already preserves the action-to-endpoint movement.

words.gloss_range: comparison particle introducing the result image while preserving likeness rather than identity
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) is formally tiny but decides how the result is read. It binds the final noun to the making verb as a comparison, so the reached thing is made like the decay image rather than simply declared identical with it. This preserves the simile's gap while still delivering the ayah's culminating picture: transformation lands through resemblance to crumbled remains.

topics.headline: likeness, not identity
topics.summary: The comparison particle makes the result phrase a simile rather than a bare second object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the semantic gap: the thing is rendered like the decay image, not simply equated with it.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as comparison, and attachment evidence makes the final noun its governed complement.

topics.headline: bound result image
topics.summary: The particle binds the final noun to the verb as the resultative comparison endpoint.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah funnel into an image endpoint through the comparison marker.
topics.reason: The particle governs the final noun and attaches the comparison phrase to the making verb.

topics.headline: recitation link duplicates syntax
topics.summary: The sound-link row repeats the stronger bound-particle payoff.
topics.reason: The bound-result-image topic already captures the particle's dependence on the final noun.

words.gloss_range: the decayed, crumbled remains; definite singular comparison endpoint governed by the preceding comparison particle
words.root_gloss_range: the broader root includes mending or repair and decayed remains; this local derivative selects the decay endpoint, with repair only as root-family tension
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّمِيمِ}} ({{tr:al-ramīmi}}) is the ayah's landing image. Its genitive case keeps it governed by the comparison particle, so the endpoint remains likeness rather than direct identity. The definite singular presents decay as a recognizable category, not just scattered debris, while the form and lexical evidence push the image toward thorough crumbling and powder-like remains. The root {{ar:ر م م}} ({{tr:r-m-m}}) carries a striking repair-versus-decay tension, but the local derivative selects irreparable breakdown. Because the word is rare and also appears in 36:78, the final image can point beyond destruction: here decay is what the wind produces, while there decay is the stated problem from which revivification is asked. The closing position and the long boundary sound make decay the final take-away after the negative-exception funnel has exhausted every spared alternative.

topics.headline: governed endpoint of comparison
topics.summary: The final noun is genitive because the comparison particle governs it, preserving likeness rather than identity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the final decay image inside a simile frame instead of flattening it into direct identity.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark the noun as genitive under the comparison particle.

topics.headline: definite known decay category
topics.summary: The definite singular noun concentrates the endpoint as a recognizable state of decomposition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the outcome as the known category of decomposition, not merely one random decayed object or many debris types.
topics.reason: The noun is definite singular and concrete in the local grammar.

topics.headline: thorough crumbling endpoint
topics.summary: The form and lexical sense make the endpoint concrete and intensified rather than mild damage.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the result as tactile, powder-like decay and complete structural breakdown.
topics.reason: The local noun is a concrete decay derivative, and the CRITICAL rows support intensive endpoint force.

topics.headline: repair root names breakdown
topics.summary: The broader root includes repair, but the local derivative selects decay and turns that root family into an image of irreparable breakdown.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tension that a root family including repair supplies the ayah's final image of irreversible decay.
topics.reason: The repair branch is real lexical background, but the local noun and context select the decay branch.

topics.headline: rare word links destruction and remaking
topics.summary: The rare word also appears in 36:78, where decayed bones become the problem posed to resurrection.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word marks destruction's endpoint here and the starting problem for revivification in 36:78.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the local form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete paired reference 36:78.

topics.headline: decay as closure and output
topics.summary: The final position makes decay the closing image, while 51:41's barren wind is shown producing only decay.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the barren wind of 51:41 demonstrated by its product in 51:42: no growth or fertility, only the closing image of decay.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah and is linked by the CRITICAL rows to the previous ayah's barren wind description.

topics.headline: sound reinforces closure
topics.summary: The nasal and repeated-sound rows can reinforce closure, but they remain secondary to lexical decay.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear the final word bind negation and endpoint acoustically, while the lexical image of decay remains primary.
topics.reason: The sound observations are plausible only as support for the closing image, not as independent semantic evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative ma...min construction, the relative clause atat alayhi, and the illa result clause jointly scope the claim over every encountered entity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival defines a contact set; the exception then assigns every member of that set one transformed output state, leaving no unchanged survivor.

activation_trace.role: Literal leaving supplies the excluded outcome: nothing within the contact set is left as it was.
The general knowable or reportable entity gives the quantifier its maximally broad object domain.
Coming and reaching delimit the domain by actual encounter rather than unrestricted cosmic totality.
State-transformation supplies the causal operation applied uniformly after contact.
Decay and what remains after breaking define the common terminal state.

changed_reading.before: The wind destroys whatever it hits.
changed_reading.after: Every entity admitted to the wind's contact set is exhaustively converted into one residue-state; none exits the encounter unchanged.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tadharu and ramim carry branch images of detached pieces, cutting, crumbs, and remnants after rupture.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can be tracked as a material sequence: coherent object, separation or cutting, then friable remainder; destruction is loss of internal joining, not mere disappearance.

activation_trace.role: A detached piece literalizes the intermediate fragments that the negated verb refuses to spare.
Cutting supplies the loss-of-cohesion operation behind the resulting fragments.
Transformation orders disassembly toward a resultant condition rather than random scattering.
Earthy crumbs and surface litter supply the fine-grained endpoint of disassembly.
What remains after breakage keeps the endpoint materially present rather than annihilated.

changed_reading.after: The wind unjoins coherent things through a piece-and-cut phase until only friable remnants remain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Atat alayhi presents traversal over a contacted surface, while the ati and ramim inventories admit channel, incoming-flow, and surface-detritus images.
baseline_models.mechanism: A moving force traces a route whose wake is diagnosed by deposited crumbs; universality is intensive along the route, not necessarily spatially unrestricted.

activation_trace.role: A directed channel supplies the path geometry through which the arriving force is imagined to move.
An incoming flow from elsewhere supplies a mobile front entering the affected zone.
Leaving marks what the moving front deposits behind itself.
Surface crumbs make the wake materially visible as a trail of detritus.

changed_reading.before: A blast ruins objects at isolated impact points.
changed_reading.after: A moving front writes its route onto the terrain as a continuous wake of deposited detritus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement from relied-on support and a mutually reinforcing host to seizure and casting widens shay beyond isolated bodies: organized power itself can be unjoined and reduced to remainder.

activation_trace.role: The broad entity category can include a formation or support-system, not only a discrete object.
Detached pieces supply the post-collapse condition of an unjoined collective.
Remainder after rupture supplies the terminal state of the collapsed assemblage.
A strong side relied upon supplies the load-bearing support that can fail.
A mutually supporting host supplies collective organization as an object of collapse.
Seizure and capture remove the collective's freedom to remain structurally intact.
Casting supplies the outward dispersal that follows loss of support.

structural_cues: 51:39-40 moves from reliance on a strong side through army-scale seizure to collective casting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: support, a mutually reinforcing host, seizure, and casting occur in sequence. Reader: I treat that sequence as a collapse arrow and admit organized power into shay. Alternative: shay may denote only the individual material bodies struck by the wind.

changed_reading.before: The clause inventories ruined individual objects.
changed_reading.after: The clause also models the teardown of supporting relations and collective power, which end as disconnected remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately identified actor is a dispatched wind marked by sterility; against ati's latent yield branch, ramim becomes not just damage but residue from which no productive continuation emerges.

activation_trace.role: Yield and emerging growth supply the productive possibility that this arrival reverses.
Transformation fixes the encountered thing in the nonproductive output state.
Decayed post-breakage remainder supplies a state with no visible continuity of growth.
Dispatch gives the wind's arrival a directed source-to-target trajectory.
Moving air identifies the feminine agent whose effects the focus clause enumerates.
Reproductive sterility supplies the absence of issue or successor as a result-level image.

structural_cues: 51:41 names the feminine wind and qualifies it as aqim immediately before 51:42 continues with feminine verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a dispatched wind is called sterile, while the focus branches juxtapose yield with decay. Reader: I project sterility through the contact-to-result arrow as suppression of renewal. Alternative: aqim may characterize only what the wind fails to carry, without describing the struck things' future.

changed_reading.before: The wind leaves things looking decayed after impact.
changed_reading.after: The wind converts productive entities into terminal residue, cancelling not only present form but the possibility of regrowth or issue.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded interval of continued use closes into a state from which neither standing nor aid is possible; ramim therefore names terminal incapacity after a timed threshold, not only a damaged appearance.

activation_trace.role: State-transformation supplies the threshold crossing into terminal incapacity.
Post-breakage remainder supplies the state from which recovery would have to occur.
Extended retention for enjoyment supplies a temporary pre-impact continuation.
An appointed occasion bounds that continuation and marks the closing threshold.
Bodily rising supplies the minimal recovery operation that the aftermath blocks.
Aid supplies the external recovery path that is likewise unavailable.

structural_cues: 51:43 grants continuation until a time; 51:44-45 then narrates seizure followed by inability to rise or obtain aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: reprieve is bounded, then both self-rising and external aid fail. Reader: I read jaalat-hu as the irreversible threshold connecting those states. Alternative: the recovery failure belongs only to the Thamud episode and need not define ramim.

changed_reading.before: Ruin is an instantaneous visual endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Ruin is the terminal side of a timed threshold: continued use ends, and neither internal recovery nor external restoration remains available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding construction and pairing sequence activates an inverse material grammar: what is built by joining and created in pairs is met by separation, cutting, and crumbs.

activation_trace.role: A separated piece supplies the inverse of joined construction.
Cutting supplies the operation that reverses compositional joining.
Transformation carries the object from composed form into decomposed condition.
Crumbs and surface litter supply the decomposed endpoint.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructive process that the focus mechanism reverses.
The repeated general entity term links the creation inventory back to the focus clause's exhaustive object domain.
Measured formation supplies ordered structure before its destructive reversal.
Joining one counterpart to another supplies relation and pairing as additional structure to be unmade.

structural_cues: 51:47-49 follows the ruin clause with build, spread, create, and pair language, and repeats shay at 51:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: building joins parts, creation measures form, pairing joins counterparts, and shay recurs. Reader: I reverse those supplied arrows through the focus branches of cutting and crumbs. Alternative: the constructive sequence may contrast with ruin without specifying an exact inverse operation.

changed_reading.before: The wind applies undifferentiated destruction to existing things.
changed_reading.after: The wind performs a precise decreation: joined, measured, paired structure is run backward into separated, friable remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later coupling of gathered rope-like strength with extended solidity activates a mechanical reading of the focus: tensile coherence and hard continuity are both cut down into friable matter.

activation_trace.role: Cutting supplies failure across bundled or tensile coherence.
State-conversion maps resistant structure into a materially opposite condition.
Crumbs supply friability as the opposite of coherent strength and solidity.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies a tensile resistance class for the material analogy.
Extended solidity supplies continuous hardness as a second resistance class.

structural_cues: 51:58 couples qawiyy and matin in one predication after the creation and provision sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the branch inventories supply bundled strength and extended solidity. Reader: I use them only as resistance analogies that the focus's cutting-to-crumbs process defeats. Alternative: in 51:58 they are divine predicates and may contribute no victim-material mechanics at all.

changed_reading.before: The wind is simply stronger than whatever it encounters.
changed_reading.after: The wind converts two kinds of integrity, bundled tensile strength and extended solidity, into the same friable output.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence of allotted share, equivalence with companions, delayed timing, and appointed event turns ka-al-ramim into a repeatable result-template within a succession of peoples, not merely one local aftermath.

activation_trace.role: The general entity domain supplies repeatable inputs rather than one named object.
Uniform state-conversion supplies a standardized output operation.
The recognizable post-breakage remainder supplies the common result-template.
An allotted share supplies measured distribution of an outcome across recipients.
Equivalence supplies the rule by which one group's share matches another's.
Companionship supplies the comparison class of prior recipients.
Hastening supplies the premature timing explicitly denied to the recipients.
The severe event of a day supplies the eventual realization point.
An appointment fixed by time supplies scheduling for the repeated outcome.

structural_cues: 51:59-60 closes the sequence by comparing shares with predecessors, refusing haste, and naming an appointed day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a share is made equivalent to companions' shares and assigned an unhurried appointment. Reader: I let that recurrence sharpen the focus simile into a standardized result-pattern. Alternative: the comparison may concern punishment generally, while ramim remains unique to the wind episode.

changed_reading.before: Like ramim describes the appearance left by one historical wind.
changed_reading.after: Like ramim functions as one instantiation of a repeatable, measured outcome-pattern allotted across a sequence of comparable recipients.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports hydraulic mechanics into a wind clause. It remains anchored in ati's own channel and incoming-flow branches, ramim's surface detritus, and the nearby casting into the great water. Render it only as a cross-medium flow analogy, never as an identification of the wind with water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Atat alayhi can activate a directed channel or incoming flood, while ramim can denote crumbs lying on the surface.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse and its directed passage supply channelized motion for the analogy.
A flood arriving from elsewhere supplies the advancing front that enters an unaffected zone.
Separated pieces supply transported fragments in the flow's wake.
Surface crumbs supply the deposited load after scouring.
Casting supplies displacement into a receiving medium rather than decay in place.
The great body of water activates the otherwise latent hydraulic register of ati.

changed_reading.before: An airborne blast decays objects where they stand.
changed_reading.after: The wind can be pictured, by analogy, as an incoming channelized flow that scours its route, transports fragments, and deposits a detrital wake.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because ramim ordinarily foregrounds decay, yet its inventory explicitly includes silence, lip movement without articulated speech, and silencing calamities; repeated qawl around the focus and a severe sound keep the activation anchored. Render it as a secondary rhetorical effect of physical ruin, not a replacement for the decay reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Jaalat-hu fixes an output state, and the ramim inventory permits that state to resonate with enforced silence or speech reduced to unarticulated mouth movement.

activation_trace.role: State-transformation supplies the forced passage from speaking agency to mute remainder.
Collective or individual silence supplies the speechless endpoint.
Mouth movement without articulated words supplies a residue of speech-form after voice has failed.
A calamity that silences supplies the causal bridge between destruction and muteness.
Overt utterance supplies the active speech-state before destructive closure.
A severe overwhelming sound supplies an acoustic force that paradoxically ends in silence.
Speech spreading among people supplies the recurring accusation-loop that the mute remainder interrupts.

changed_reading.before: Ramim names only the physical remains of destroyed bodies and structures.
changed_reading.after: Physical ruin also becomes forced muteness: a repeated social speech-loop terminates in bodies that can no longer articulate a reply.

strongest_changes: The immediate aqim cue changes decay into generative termination: nothing struck carries renewal forward.
The build-create-pair sequence changes generic destruction into a directional decreation from joined structure to crumbs.
The reprieve, standing, and aid sequence changes a visual aftermath into a timed terminal state with no recovery path.
The final share-equivalence-appointment sequence changes one wind episode into an instance of a repeatable result-pattern.
summary.what_was_special: The focus branches exposed a piece-cut-crumb material sequence, while context preserved two easily lost activations: wind as hydraulic scour by analogy and ramim as a physically ruined, forcibly silenced endpoint.
remaining_uncertainties: Aqim may describe only the wind's lack of benefit rather than the victims' inability to regenerate.
The decreation mechanism may be a reader-supplied reversal across juxtaposed passages rather than an encoded causal inverse.
The hydraulic, mechanical-resistance, and silence readings should remain exploratory analogies rather than replacements for decay.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Arrival converts formed things into worn remains.** `و ذ ر/B003` supplies leaving/letting be; `ش ي ء/B001` a knowable thing; `ء ت ي/B001` arrival; `ج ع ل/B002` turning into a state; `ر م م/B004` crumbling remains. The exception construction gives the wind a universal conversion rule. I infer **wind reaches entity -> cohesion stripped -> remnant-state**. The line reads as systematic material unmaking.
2. **The wind leaves nothing, yet leaves a trace.** The negated `و ذ ر/B003` says it spares no encountered thing, while *ramīm* means remains. In relation to the deliberately left sign of 51:37, I infer **living form erased -> decayed residue remains as evidence**. Non-preservation of the object coexists with preservation of its warning trace.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:47-49's constructive sequence supplied the surprising inverse: joined building and proportion produce inhabitable form, while this arrival reduces form to residue.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Contact triggers total state-conversion.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `و ذ ر/B003` is leaving or letting be; fixed `ش ي ء/B001` selects the “knowable thing” variant-image; fixed `ء ت ي/B001` is coming and arriving; fixed `ج ع ل/B002` is turning something into a state; fixed `ر م م/B004` is “worn-out crumbling remains.” **Structural cue:** the sterile wind is named in 51:41; timed enjoyment, thunderbolt, inability to rise, prior transgression, and then the strongly built sky follow in 51:43–47. **Role and abduction:** arrival supplies contact, the exceptive construction makes transformation universal over encountered objects, and crumbling is the resulting state; I infer the wind as conversion mechanism. **Reading change:** the ayah describes systematic de-formation, sharpened by the later contrast with construction through joined strength.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:47’s joined, reinforced sky supplied a surprising anti-image at the window’s edge: crumbling separation in 51:42 is answered by construction that holds parts together.

Sel, kendi yağmurunu almamış bir bölgeye ulaşıp oradan geçer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yerel yağıştan doğmayan ve yağmur alan başka bir yerden geçerek gelen sel sınırında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Selin ulaştığı yerde yağmur yağmamış, su başka bir yağış alanından gelmişse kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Selin dışarıdaki yağış alanından gelmesi koşulunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden gelen sel

error_profile.preserves: Akan büyük su kütlesi olma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.adds: Yerel yağmurdan doğan selleri de kapsayarak zorunlu dış kaynak koşulunu kaldırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sel, yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden yağmur almamış bölgeye gelmelidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü su akışını, akıtmayı, akan suyu ve akış yerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da yatakta ilerleyen akan su bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kaynağı ve hedef bölgenin yağış durumuyla sınırlı özel bir sel türüdür; komşu dal genel akış alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel su akışı dalı, bu kalıbın dışarıdan gelme koşulunu en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: السيل الذي يأتي من بلد أصابه المطر إلى بلد لم يصبه المطر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجدول المصنوع ولا الغريب من الناس
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأتي السيل بعينه يأتيك من بلد مطر من غير بلدك (jamhara)؛ سيل أتي وأتاوي إذا جاءك ولم يصبك مطره (sihah)؛ المسيل الذي يأتي من بلد قد مطر فيه إلى بلد لم يمطر فيه أتي (tahdhib)؛ السيل المار على وجهه أتي وأتاوي (mufradat)؛ الأتي أيضا السيل الذي يأتي من بلد غير بلدك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, içinde bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı erkeği ortak biçimde tanımlar ve dal çerçevesindeki sınırı doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız bir topluluk içinde onlardan olmayan yabancı kişi nitelemesine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi niteleyen kalıpla sınırlıdır; her gelen kişi veya dışarıdan gelen sel bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluk içinde bulunan, fakat o topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı erkektir.

facets.statement: Kişi bir topluluğun içinde bulunur ancak o topluluktan değildir.
Kişi topluluğa göre yabancı ve dışarıdan gelmiş sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmaması ve bu nedenle yabancı sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin içinde bulunduğu topluluğun mensubu olmadığını belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk içinde bulunma ve ona mensup olmama sınırını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: içinde bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı adam

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin gruba göre dışarıdan oluşunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Bir topluluk içinde bulunmayan kişiler ile tanınmayan şeyleri de kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin topluluğa yabancı oluşunu bildirir, sonradan karışma biçimini zorunlu kılmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal topluluğa dışarıdan girip ona karışan kişi görünümünü özellikle taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir topluluk içinde o topluluktan olmayan kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mensubiyet dışılığını merkez alır; komşu dal dışarıdan girme ve topluluğa karışma görünümünü daha belirgin taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; topluluğa karışmış yabancı dalı mensubiyet ile sonradan giriş arasındaki farkı en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: الرجل الغريب في قوم ليس منهم، وما يقال له أَتِيّ أو أتاوي
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل آت مطلقا ولا السيل الآتي من بلد آخر
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل أتي وأتاوي وهو الغريب (jamhara)؛ الاتي أيضا والاتاوى الغريب (sihah)؛ إنما هو أتي فينا (tahdhib)؛ به شبه الغريب فقيل أتاوي (mufradat)؛ رجل أتي أي غريب في قوم ليس منهم وأتاوي كذلك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ekin ve hurmanın ürünü, gelişmesi ve bol verimi ile suyun çoğalmasını destekler. Çalkalanan tulumdan yağın çıkması ise yalnız ayrı kalıbın kaynak ifadesiyle açıklanabilen, çekirdeğe bağlı olmayan bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitkisel ürün ve artış çekirdektir; suyun çoğalması uzantı, tulumdan yağ çıkması ise ayrı kalıp kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ürün ve gelişme bildiren biçim, suyun çoğalması ve çalkalanan tulumda yağın belirmesini bildiren kalıptan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ekin ve hurmanın gelişip ürün vermesi, ürününün ve veriminin bol olmasıdır; suyun çoğalması da bu artış alanına uzanır. Ayrı bir kalıp, çalkalanan tulumda yağın ortaya çıkmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ekin veya hurma gelişir, ürün verir ve verimi artar.
Suyun miktarı çoğalır.
Ayrı bir kalıpta çalkalanan tulumun yağı ortaya çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bol verimi merkez alır; su artışı ve tulum yağının belirmesi farklı kapsamlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ekin veya hurmanın gelişmesi, ürün çıkarması ve veriminin artması birlikte anlatılacağında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bolluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ekinin veya hurmanın çıkan ürünü ve yüksek verimi adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin ürünü ile verim bolluğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelişme sürecini, suyun çoğalmasını ve tulum yağı kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ekin ve hurmanın gelişmesi, ürünü ve bol verimi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ürünün yanında gelişme, verim bolluğu ve suyun çoğalması kapsamlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ağaç, hurma, ekin ve toprağın verdiği ürünü daha genel bir ürün adı olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ekin ve hurmanın meydana getirdiği ürünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ürünle birlikte gelişme ve bolluk sürecini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ürünün kendisine daha genel biçimde yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ürün dalı, ürünün kendisi ile gelişme ve bol verim arasındaki ayrımı en iyi belirginleştirdi.
branches.what_is_ar: ريع الزرع والنخل وثمرهما، وكثرة الماء، وما يجيء من زبد السقاء عند الصحاح والمفردات
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإيتاء بمعنى الإعطاء ولا الإتاوة المفروضة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أتاء هذا النخل أي ثمره وكذلك الزرع (jamhara)؛ الاتاء البركة والنماء وحمل النخل (sihah)؛ جاء أتوه (sihah;mufradat)؛ إتاء النخلة ريعها وزكاؤها وكثرة ثمارها (tahdhib)؛ الإتاء نماء الزرع والنخل وأتى الماء إتاء أي كثر (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yönetime ödenen vergi veya baş vergisini ortak alan olarak verir ve aynı toplu iddia içinde bir kişiye sunulan rüşvet kullanımını da bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Düzenli veya zorunlu kamu ödemesi çekirdektir; rüşvet, aynı biçimin ayrı kalıptaki özel kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Vergi adı olarak kullanılan biçim ile birine rüşvet vermeyi bildiren kalıp kapsam bakımından ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun veya kişinin yönetime ödediği vergi ya da baş vergisidir. Ayrı bir kalıpta, bir kimseye çıkar sağlamak için verilen rüşveti veya rüşvet verme eylemini anlatır.

facets.statement: Topluluk veya kişi yönetime vergi niteliğinde para öder.
Ödeme baş vergisi veya benzeri yükümlülük niteliği taşır.
Ayrı bir kullanımda bir kimseye rüşvet verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia vergi ve baş vergisi anlamlarını ortaklaştırır; rüşvet kullanımı kaynaklara ayrı ayrı dağıtılamayan özel bir karşılık olarak aynı iddiada yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yönetime ödenen mali yükümlülük ile ayrı rüşvet kullanımı birlikte gösterileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Vergi, baş vergisi ve ayrı rüşvet kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun veya kişinin yönetime yaptığı zorunlu mali ödeme söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönetime yapılan mali yükümlülük ödemesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Rüşvet olarak verilen ödeme kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal aynı biçimin rüşvet kullanımını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişiye, köleye veya toprağa konan vergi, gelir ve görev ödemelerini daha geniş sınıflar halinde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişi veya topluluğa yüklenen vergi ve kamu ödemesi alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal vergi adının yanında rüşvet kullanımına sahiptir; komşu dal ise üzerine konan mali yükümlülük türlerini daha geniş kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; mali yükümlülük komşusu vergi çekirdeği ile rüşvet uzantısı arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: الخراج أو الجزية أو الرشوة التي يؤديها القوم أو الشخص
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإيتاء بمعنى مطلق الإعطاء ولا ريع الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإتاوة الخراج أو الجزية يؤديه القوم إلى الملك (jamhara)؛ الاتاوة الخراج والجمع الاتاوي (sihah)؛ الإتاوة الخراج وجمعها الأتاوى والإتاوات (tahdhib)؛ أتوته أتوة إذا رشوته إتاوة وهي الرشوة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bütünüyle devenin yürüyüş sırasında ön ayaklarını geri getirme hareketini anlatır ve verilen dal sınırıyla örtüşür.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız devenin yürüyüşte ön ayaklarını geri getirme biçimini niteleyen kalıba bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım devenin ön ayak hareketini bildiren kalıpla sınırlıdır; genel yürüyüş veya geliş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Devenin yürürken ön ayaklarını ileri adımdan sonra düzenli biçimde geri getirme hareketidir.

facets.statement: Deve yürüyüş sırasında ön ayaklarını geri getirir.
Bu hareket devenin yürüyüş niteliği olarak değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, devenin yürüyüşünde ön ayakların geri getirilişini aynı hareket niteliği olarak tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin yürüyüşündeki belirli ön ayak hareketi adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanı, yürüyüş bağlamını ve ön ayakların geri hareketini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: devenin yürürken ön ayaklarını geri getirişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal özellikle devenin ön ayaklarını geri getirmesine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal farklı bineklerin ayak hareketini, adımını ve bir yürüyüş türünden ötekine geçişini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yürüyen bir hayvanın ayaklarını geri getirme hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal deve ve ön ayaklarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal hayvan ve yürüyüş türü bakımından daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel binek ayağı hareketi komşusu, deveye ve ön ayaklara özgü sınırı en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: أتو أو أتي يدي الناقة، أي رجع يديها في السير
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الإتيان ولا طريق الماء
branches.source_phrase_ar: ما أحسن أتو قوائم الناقة وأتيها في السير (jamhara)؛ ما أحسن أتو يدي هذه الناقة وأتي أيضا أي رجع يديها في السير (sihah)؛ ما أحسن أتو يديها وأتي يديها يعني رجع يديها (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yarışın son sınırı, işlek ya da yürünmüş yol, yol kavşağı ve bir evin karşısında veya hizasında olma kullanımlarını açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yol adı, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama aynı biçim ailesindeki ayrı kullanımlardır; biri ötekine indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yol ve son sınır bildiren adlar ile bir evin karşısında bulunmayı bildiren kalıp ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: İşlek veya yürünmüş ana yol, yolların birleştiği yer ya da yarış atlarının koşusunun bittiği son sınırdır. Bir konum kalıbında, bir evin karşısında veya onunla aynı hizada bulunmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: İnsanların kullandığı işlek veya yürünmüş ana yol adlandırılır.
Yolların birleştiği kavşak veya yolun belirgin ana kesimi anlatılır.
Yarış atlarının koşusunun ulaştığı son sınır adlandırılır.
Bir yapı başka bir yapının karşısında veya aynı hizasında bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt yol, kavşak ve yarış sonu anlamlarını; ayrıca yapıların karşı karşıya veya aynı hizada oluşunu bildiren kalıbı bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.text: işlek ana yol, son sınır ve karşı hizası
concept_gloss.applicability: Yol ailesindeki temel adlar ile yarış sonu ve karşıda bulunma kullanımları topluca temsil edileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yol, kavşak, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama kapsamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların yürüdüğü veya yolların birleştiği belirgin yol adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlek ve yürünmüş yol anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yarış sonu ile bir yapının karşısında veya hizasında bulunma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yarışın son sınırı; işlek ana yol veya yol kavşağı
yarışın son sınırı veya yolun ana kesimi
bir evin karşısında veya aynı hizasında

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yarışın son sınırını ve bir yapının karşısındaki hizayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yolun toplandığı ana cadde ve bu caddeyi tutma eylemiyle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal işlek ana yol ve yolların birleştiği yer anlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yol çekirdeğinin ötesinde yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama kullanımlarına sahiptir; komşu dal bu uzantıları taşımaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ana yol ve kavşak komşusu, dalın yol dışındaki yarış sonu ve hizalama kapsamlarını en iyi açığa çıkardı.
branches.what_is_ar: الميتاء والميداء: آخر الغاية، والطريق العامر أو المسلوك، ومجتمع الطريق، ومحاذاة الدار
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجيء الشخص ولا الجدول المائي
branches.source_phrase_ar: الميتاء والميداء آخر الغاية حيث ينتهي إليه جري الخيل (sihah)؛ الميتاء الطريق العامر ومجتمع الطريق (sihah)؛ داري بميتاء دار فلان وميداء دار فلان أي تلقاء داره ومحاذية لها (sihah)؛ طريق ميتاء مسلوك وميتاء الطريق وميداؤه محجته (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kalıplarda kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesini; malın yok olmasını; kişinin öldürülüp götürülmesini ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını destekler. Genel olarak gelişin iyi veya kötü olabileceği notu, bu dalın yalnız zararlı kalıplarını genişletmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen zarar ve tehdit kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel gelme eylemi veya her türlü yok oluş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ölüm, hastalık, mal kaybı, yenilgi ve düşman yaklaşması anlamları yalnız kendi kalıplarında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesi; malının yok olması; öldürülüp götürülmesi ya da düşmanın ona yaklaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya uzuv kırılması gibi ağır bir zarara uğrar.
Bir kişinin malı yok olur.
Bir kişi öldürülür, götürülür veya üzerinde üstünlük kurulur.
Düşman kişiye yaklaşır ve tehdit oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, farklı kalıplarda kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve yaklaşan düşman tehdidini sıralar; genel gelişin olumlu da olabileceği ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: felakete uğramak, kaybetmek veya düşmanca ele geçirilmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Kanıttaki farklı zarar kalıplarının ortak olumsuz sonucunu topluca göstermek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve düşman tehdidi kapsamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gibi kişisel zarar anlatan kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin ağır bir zarara uğramasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Mal kaybını, öldürülüp götürülmeyi ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırığa uğramak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ağır hastalık ve kırığı, mal kaybını, kişinin götürülmesini ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını ayrı kalıplarda kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi bütünüyle yok etme ve kökünü kazıma eylemini merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ölüm, kayıp ve ağır yıkım sonuçlarında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal farklı zarar olaylarının kişiye veya malına erişmesini anlatan kalıplardır; komşu dalın çekirdeği doğrudan ve tam yok etmedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kökten yok oluş komşusu, zarar kalıpları ile doğrudan yok etme çekirdeği arasındaki farkı en iyi gösterdi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu yapıyı ardından gelen eyleme başlama veya girişme anlamında ve nesne almayan bir kuruluş olarak ortaklaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca öznenin hemen ardından belirtilen eyleme giriştiğini bildiren yapı bağımlı kullanımı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleme girişme aşamasını ve yapıya bağlı kullanım koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ardından gelen eylemin özne tarafından başlatıldığını bildiren geçmiş zamanlı cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Öznenin belirtilen eyleme giriştiği başlangıç aşamasını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye yapacağı iş veya yerine getireceği görev karşılığında ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağanı açıkça tanımlar. İnsanların bir sefer veya önemli iş için aralarında kararlaştırdıkları ortak ödemeler de aynı karşılık belirleme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal iş veya görev karşılığında belirlenen ödemedir; genel armağanı, yapılan işi, durum değiştirmeyi ve tencere bezini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad alanına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yapacağı iş veya görev karşılığında ona verilmek üzere belirlenen ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır. Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş için aralarında kararlaştırdığı ödemeler de bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Belirli bir iş veya görevin yapılması karşılığında bir kişiye ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır.
Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş sırasında kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödemeleri de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iş karşılığında önceden ayrılan ücret veya armağanda birleşir; topluca kararlaştırılan ödemeler bu çekirdeğin özel biçimi olarak aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: iş karşılığı belirlenen ücret veya ortaklaşa kararlaştırılan ödeme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir kişiye iş için ayrılan karşılığı hem de bir topluluğun önemli iş için kararlaştırdığı ödeme biçimini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: İşe bağlı karşılık belirleme ile ortak ödeme özel durumunu korur.

error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödeme özel durumunu dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir bitki adını bahar otu, belirli bir çöl otu veya bir tür ağaç olarak açıklar; çoğul ya da topluluk görünümü aynı bitkinin çokluğunu da gösterebilir. Dal çerçevesi kaynaklardaki tür belirsizliğini saklamadan korur.
